correctness.rationale: Exact 1152-element Coxeter enumeration from four rational simple-root reflection matrices; independent reflection-word BFS verifies all 1152 absolute lengths, NC interval ranks (1,24,55,24,1) and chain counts (103,468,432). Faithful effective conjugation group C6 has quotient cells (19,78,72), signed integer boundary product zero, Smith nonzero entries 1^18 for D1 and 1^60 for D2, proving H1=0 and H2=Z^12. Shellability proves the cover simply connected; vertex isotropy C3 and C2 normally generate the acting C6, proving quotient pi1 trivial by Armstrong. The homological Whitehead theorem then yields wedge of twelve 2-spheres. Complete verifier code and replay output supplied.

value.rationale: A natural exceptional Coxeter type provides a full ordinary geometric quotient homotopy classification; integral zero torsion and vanishing fundamental group cannot be read off from known cyclic sieving or unquotiented shellability. Both 2- and 3-isotropy are essential, while the nontrivial exact cellular integer boundary calculation distinguishes sphere-wedge from possible Moore/torsion alternatives. Complete F4 classification is a motivated structural boundary example rather than arbitrary truncation.
